verdict.rationale: TrueLayer handles users' bank account, identity and transaction data, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never documents retention settings, deletion endpoints or data-purge controls. The closest items cover storing account details and consent (docs-6) and reading account data (docs-28), which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
